latestVersion.changelog:
Initial release of cloud-data-migration skill.

- Enables generation of comprehensive data migration plans between major cloud vendors.
- Supports migrations for relational databases, NoSQL, data warehouses, big data platforms, object storage, and data lakes.
- Automatically recommends target products, migration tools, strategies, and provides risk assessments and best practice guidance.
- Offers detailed workflow for input analysis, product mapping, strategy and tool selection, and step-by-step migration planning.
- Includes extensive reference tables for product mapping and migration tools across AWS, Azure, GCP, Alibaba Cloud, Huawei Cloud, Tencent Cloud, and Volcano Engine.
